nodes.description: Privileged owner address set in constructor to msg.sender; gate for init, batchSend, setTradeAddress, _mints and delegate.
Public mapping of token balances, mutated directly with unchecked arithmetic.
Public nested mapping of allowances, written by approve and decremented in transferFrom.
Whitelisted trading address set by setTradeAddress, bypasses the sale-condition check in ensure().
Whitelist mapping; entries set to true in _mints bypass ensure() checks in transferFrom.
Per-address sale counter incremented on every transferFrom and compared against _saleNum.
Minimum sale amount configured through init().
Maximum sale amount configured through init().
Maximum number of sales per address configured through init().
Total token supply minted to the owner in the constructor.
Hardcoded Uniswap router constant used as whitelist bypass in ensure().
Public payable transfer that forwards to transferFrom with msg.sender as source.
Whitelist/condition gate deciding whether a transfer is permitted.
Core transfer routine updating allowance, balanceOf and _onSaleNum with unchecked arithmetic.
Public payable approval writing allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
Validates sale count and min/max sale thresholds using _saleNum, _minSale, _maxSale.
Owner-only function performing an arbitrary delegatecall to a attacker-controlled address and bytes.
Privileged mint that overwrites balances and whitelists spender.
Owner-only sale parameter initializer writing _minSale, _maxSale and _saleNum.
Owner-only loop distributing tokens with unchecked balance arithmetic and fake Transfer events.
Owner-only setter for the tradeAddress whitelist slot.
Pure helper computing a Uniswap pair address via keccak256 for the whitelist check.
Payable constructor minting total supply to msg.sender and granting unlimited allowance to the Uniswap router.
Caller-controlled address used as authority, source, spender and whitelist key.
Block timestamp; not consumed by this contract but tracked as untrusted input.
Origin of the transaction; not consumed but tracked as untrusted input.
Raw a.delegatecall(b) executes arbitrary attacker code in the token's storage context.
Direct balance/allowance += / -= and _value * _tos.length without SafeMath (arithmetic risk).
Destination address of transfer.
Amount transferred by transfer.
Source address of transferFrom.
Destination address of transferFrom.
Amount moved by transferFrom.
Spender authorised by approve.
Allowance amount set by approve.
Source address checked against whitelists in ensure.
Destination address checked in ensure.
Value forwarded to condition in ensure.
Address whose _onSaleNum counter is inspected.
Value compared with _minSale and _maxSale.
Target contract address for delegatecall.
Calldata bytes forwarded to delegatecall.
Address whose balance is overwritten and whitelisted.
Raw token amount assigned in _mints.
Sale count limit written to _saleNum.
Minimum sale token amount written to _minSale.
Maximum sale token amount written to _maxSale.
Array of recipient addresses.
Per-recipient amount in batchSend.
New whitelisted trade address.
Local total = _value * _tos.length computed unchecked.
Loop-local recipient address inside batchSend.

edges.reason: msg.sender is passed as _from when transfer delegates to transferFrom.
msg.sender is compared to _from and used to spend allowance.
msg.sender keys the allowance mapping written by approve.
msg.sender must equal owner to reach the delegatecall.
msg.sender is the authorization check for _mints.
msg.sender must equal owner to run init.
msg.sender must equal owner to run batchSend.
msg.sender must equal owner to change tradeAddress.
Constructor derives owner and initial balance from msg.sender.
transfer calls transferFrom(msg.sender,_to,_value).
transferFrom requires ensure(_from,_to,_value) before moving balances.
ensure falls through to condition() for non-whitelisted senders.
ensure derives the pair address with pairFor for the whitelist comparison.
ensure compares _from against the hardcoded UNI constant.
ensure reads canSale[_from] as a whitelist bypass.
ensure reads tradeAddress as a whitelist bypass.
allowance[_from][msg.sender] is decremented with unchecked -=.
balanceOf[_from] and balanceOf[_to] are updated with unchecked += / -=.
_onSaleNum[_from] is incremented on every transferFrom.
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
_mints overwrites balanceOf[spender] with addedValue*10**decimals unchecked.
_mints sets canSale[spender] to true, whitelisting arbitrary addresses.
init writes _minSale from token.
init writes _maxSale from maxToken.
init writes _saleNum from saleNum.
condition reads _onSaleNum[_from] against _saleNum.
condition compares _value to _minSale.
condition compares _value to _maxSale.
batchSend subtracts total and adds _value per recipient without SafeMath.
total = _value * _tos.length can overflow unchecked.
Loop variable _to selects each recipient from _tos.
setTradeAddress writes the tradeAddress state variable.
delegate executes a.delegatecall(b) with caller-supplied target and data.
Code executed via delegatecall runs in this contract's context and can re-enter transferFrom before balances settle.
Constructor assigns owner = msg.sender.
Constructor sets totalSupply = _supply*10**decimals unchecked.
Constructor credits balanceOf[msg.sender] with totalSupply.
Constructor sets unlimited allowance for the Uniswap router.
Timestamp is not used for ordering/sale logic, so timing-dependent ordering (e.g. sale windows) can be manipulated by miners.
Authorization relies on caller identity rather than tx.origin; a relayed tx.origin is not enforced.
